summary: FreeCol entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: FreeCol
entries.definitive_edition: Current FreeCol release with Java/version/ruleset state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current FreeCol release with exact version and ruleset documented

primary.why: FreeCol is an open-source Colonization-like game, not the 1994 Sid Meier's Colonization original. The current Java release is the practical route, while exact version, ruleset, mods, and multiplayer state should be documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current FreeCol release from the official site or SourceForge. Record version, Java/runtime, ruleset/mods, map, nation, difficulty, multiplayer/server state, display scaling, and whether Sid Meier's Colonization was only referenced.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting release evolution.
secondary.why: Current release is the normal archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Sid Meier's Colonization or Civilization IV: Colonization.
